meta.title: Inside Out
meta.tagline: The city is a book. Someone tore out the last page.
meta.intro: Hidden across Antwerp are traces — street art with a QR code or NFC tag. The case starts at the Stadsfeestzaal on the Meir. Every trace hides a riddle that leads you to the next one. Follow them to the final page.
